notes: Sheet 6SU (Restricted Use Sub-District, Sunset / Twin Peaks), the 2000 edition (sheet still dated June 1990). Single heavy frame rule (~10 px) on the left, top and right (no outer thin rule on this sheet); The bottom edge sits just above the thick top bar of the ruled-off legend and title strip (README rule 3: the strip is outside, with the district key, the planning-code note, the north arrow, the scale bar and the sheet number printed in it, so there is no remove polygon). Each side's inner edge was measured line by line from the scan (the longest dark run across the rule, its inner end), smoothed with a robust local-linear fit (+-300 px, residuals over 2.5 px dropped, so map ink running into a rule and 1 px nubs do not pull it), and the outline set 2 px inside the fit's 95th-percentile inner edge (README rule 1: the 1-bit rules are stair-stepped with 1 px nubs), points every ~200 px; corners where the fitted sides meet, then moved 2 px further in on both axes to clear the small rounded fillets inside the frame's corners. Measured paper between outline and rule: median 2-3 px, at most 5 px anywhere (README rule 8). The page is turned (~0.5 deg: left and right rules drift ~30 px right from top to bottom; the top rule and the legend bar rise ~29-39 px, y decreasing, from left to right). 'TARAVAL STREET RESTAURANT & FAST FOOD SUB-DISTRICT (Sec. 781.1)' at the lower left is a label for the sub-district drawn on the map, with no ruled box: inside. No compass rose, legend block or SECTION badge inside the frame, so no remove polygon. GOLDEN GATE PARK, MT SUTRO, TWIN PEAKS and the block numbers are map. No map ink touches the frame. Ink under the outline: none.
